summary: The PR fixes the issue with SI._collect_factor_and_dimension() but introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect due to the use of a list comprehension with a conditional return statement.

issues.description: The use of a list comprehension with a conditional return statement can make the code harder to read and understand.
The PR does not add any new tests to cover the changed functionality, which increases the risk of introducing behavioral regressions in the future.
